description: This file is a C header file that declares external API functions for the ANSC (Advanced Networking Service Container) component, including create, remove, enroll objects, and initialize functions. It includes licensing information, purpose, and function prototypes but no actual function implementations.

methods.name: AnscCoCreate
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new ANSC container object with specified contexts.

methods.name: AnscCoRemove
methods.description: Removes and cleans up the specified ANSC container object.

methods.name: AnscCoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls necessary objects into the ANSC container.
